description: A night scene on a stone rooftop with battlements and lit torches. An older bearded man in a tall fringed hat and patterned robe points up at a crescent moon and a star in a dark sky, while a younger attendant leans beside him. In the foreground a bearded man in a tattered robe sits at a wooden table, writing marks onto a clay tablet by an oil lamp, with an hourglass and stacked tablets nearby. City lights and fires glow far below. No frame or border is visible.
